<![CDATA[import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

// The live route and download share the original self-contained document.
export function GET() {
  const html = readFileSync(path.join(process.cwd(), "public", "downloads", "velora.html"), "utf8");
  return new Response(html, { headers: { "Content-Type": "text/html; charset=utf-8" } });
}
]]>

.corridors{background:#081823;overflow:hidden;padding:120px 0 140px}.corridor-cover{position:relative;min-height:690px;display:flex;align-items:center;overflow:hidden;border-radius:32px;border:1px solid #c1ffe338;background:#0a2530;isolation:isolate}.corridor-cover>img{position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;opacity:.9;transition:transform 1s var(--ease)}.corridor-cover:hover>img{transform:scale(1.05)}.corridor-cover::before{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#071b29 0%,#071b29d0 36%,#071b2990 58%,#071b2922 100%)}.corridor-body{padding:60px;width:min(560px,100%)}.corridor-body h2{font-size:clamp(43px,5vw,78px);line-height:1.02;margin:15px 0 22px}.corridor-body p{font-size:15px;color:#a8c7c9;max-width:410px}.corridor-buttons{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:30px}.corridor-option{padding:12px 15px;border:1px solid #ccfff045;background:#13373dad;color:#dff8ef;border-radius:11px;display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;font-size:13px;transition:transform .3s,border-color .3s,background .3s}.corridor-option:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:#9af6c4}.corridor-option.active{background:#baffd9;color:#0a2a24;border-color:#baffd9}.corridor-result{margin-top:28px;display:flex;gap:17px;align-items:center;color:#ddfff1}.corridor-result .route-pulse{display:grid;place-items:center;width:46px;height:46px;background:#63e7ad24;border:1px solid #9fffc44a;border-radius:50%;font-size:20px}.corridor-result strong{display:block;font-size:18px}.corridor-result small{color:#aac5c7;font-size:12px}.corridor-note{margin-top:18px!important;font-size:11px!important;color:#86a3ac!important}
/* SECURITY */
.security{background:#f0f8f3;color:#0d302d;padding:150px 0}.security-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.06fr .94fr;gap:clamp(55px,6vw,110px);align-items:center}.security-img{position:relative;min-height:590px;border-radius:29px;overflow:hidden;background:#0a2930}.security-img img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:590px;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s var(--ease)}.security-img:hover img{transform:scale(1.045)}.security-img::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #ffffff44;border-radius:29px}.security-content h2{font-size:clamp(43px,5vw,80px);line-height:1.03;margin:14px 0 20px}.security-content>p{color:#56756f;font-size:15px;max-width:440px;margin-bottom:30px}.faq-item{border-top:1px solid #cbded5}.faq-item:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid #cbded5}.faq-q{border:0;background:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;width:100%;padding:21px 4px;text-align:left;color:#143a32;font-weight:760;font-size:15px}.faq-q .plus{width:30px;height:30px;border:1px solid #b7d1c7;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:20px;transition:background .3s,transform .4s}.faq-q:hover .plus,.faq-q[aria-expanded=true] .plus{background:#ceeee0;transform:rotate(45deg)}.faq-answer{display:grid;grid-template-rows:0fr;transition:grid-template-rows .4s var(--ease)}.faq-answer.open{grid-template-rows:1fr}.faq-inner{overflow:hidden}.faq-inner p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.65;color:#5c7770;margin:0;padding:0 12px 21px 4px}
/* TRANSPARENCY */
.transparency{background:#071925;padding:140px 0;overflow:hidden}.trans-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6vw;align-items:center}.trans-visual{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:28px;min-height:500px;border:1px solid #caffeb25;background:#071d2a}.trans-visual img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:500px;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .7s var(--ease)}.trans-visual:hover img{transform:scale(1.04)}.trans-copy h2{font-size:clamp(44px,5vw,80px);line-height:1.01;margin:20px 0}.trans-copy p{color:#9dbfc3;max-width:450px;font-size:15px}.trans-points{margin:26px 0;display:grid;gap:14px}.trans-points div{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-size:14px;color:#d2f0e7}.trans-points span{font-size:17px;color:var(--mint)}.concept-note{margin-top:11px!important;color:#72929a!important;font-size:11px!important}
/* FINAL CTA */
.final-cta{padding:130px 0 0;background:#071824;isolation:isolate;overflow:hidden}.closing-scene{position:relative;min-height:680px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;overflow:hidden;border-radius:34px;border:1px solid #dcfff032;isolation:isolate}.closing-scene>img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;z-index:-2;filter:brightness(.68);transition:transform 1s var(--ease)}.closing-scene:hover>img{transform:scale(1.035)}.closing-scene::after{content:"";position:absolute;z-index:-1;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,#09242b88,#071722bb 78%)}.closing-content{padding:40px 22px;max-width:850px}.closing-content h2{font-size:clamp(58px,7.1vw,112px);line-height:.98;margin:17px 0 22px;letter-spacing:-.08em}.closing-content h2 span{color:var(--mint)}.closing-content p{max-width:480px;margin:0 auto 28px;color:#d2e5e4;font-size:16px}.closing-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
/* FOOTER */
.footer{position:relative;padding:105px 0 30px;background:#04131d;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate}.footer-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;opacity:.25;z-index:-1;mask-image:linear-gradient(0deg,#000,transparent 93%)}.footer-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.8fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:50px;padding-bottom:100px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.footer-brand .brand{font-size:31px}.footer-brand p{max-width:340px;color:#97b4bc;font-size:13px;margin:24px 0}.footer-grid h4{font-size:12px;color:#edfff7;margin:7px 0 22px}.footer-grid a:not(.brand){display:block;color:#9ab7be;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:13px;transition:color .2s,transform .2s}.footer-grid a:not(.brand):hover{color:var(--mint);transform:translateX(4px)}.footer-bottom{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:center;padding-top:25px;color:#7796a1;font-size:11px}.footer-bottom span{letter-spacing:.05em}
/* MODAL */
dialog.signup-modal{border:1px solid #d7e9e1;border-radius:27px;padding:0;max-width:min(94vw,500px);width:100%;background:#f4fcf8;color:#0c302c;box-shadow:0 30px 130px #000b}dialog.signup-modal::backdrop{background:#021018c9;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)}.modal-inner{padding:38px}.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:15px}.modal-close{border:1px solid #d1e5dd;background:#fff;color:#174a3e;border-radius:50%;width:38px;height:38px;font-size:23px;line-height:1;transition:transform .3s,background .3s}.modal-close:hover{transform:rotate(90deg);background:#d8f6e7}.modal-inner h2{font-size:45px;line-height:1.04;letter-spacing:-.065em;margin:28px 0 12px}.modal-inner>p{color:#5d7a70;font-size:14px}.signup-form label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:750;margin:27px 0 9px}.signup-form input{width:100%;border:1px solid #bcd7cd;background:#fff;color:#123b31;padding:16px;border-radius:12px;outline-offset:3px}.signup-form .cta-btn{width:100%;margin-top:14px}.signup-disclaimer{font-size:11px!important;color:#6a8279!important;margin-top:16px}.signup-success{display:none;margin-top:22px;padding:20px;background:#d7f7e6;border-radius:15px;color:#155540;font-size:14px}.signup-success.show{display:block}
/* MICRO-INTERACTIONS — stateful text, navigation, and conversion UI */
@keyframes menuPop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-12px) scale(.985)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes modalPop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(26px) scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes copyRefresh{from{opacity:.35;transform:translateY(8px);filter:blur(3px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:blur(0)}}
.mobile-nav.open{animation:menuPop .42s var(--ease) both}
dialog.signup-modal[open]{animation:modalPop .44s var(--ease) both}
.refresh{animation:copyRefresh .46s var(--ease) both}
/* UTILITIES */
.rise-in{animation:liftIn 1.1s var(--ease) backwards}@keyframes liftIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);filter:blur(7px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:blur(0)}}

<section class="hero-runway" id="top" aria-label="Velora introduction">
 <div class="hero-frame" id="heroFrame">
  <img class="hero-atmos" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="" fetchpriority="high" aria-hidden="true">
  <div class="hero-copy" id="heroCopy">
   <div class="hero-pill mono rise-in" style="animation-delay:.08s"><i class="pulse-dot"></i> A better way to move money</div>
   <h1 class="rise-in" style="animation-delay:.16s">Money moves.<br><em>You don't wait.</em></h1>
   <p class="hero-description rise-in" style="animation-delay:.29s">Make every mile feel closer. Send money across borders with a clear fee preview and a beautifully simple experience.</p>
   <div class="hero-buttons rise-in" style="animation-delay:.4s"><button class="cta-btn cta-primary" type="button" data-open-signup>Sign up free <svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 20 20" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 16 16 4M6 4h10v10" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></svg></button><a class="cta-btn cta-outline" href="#rates">Preview a transfer <span>↗</span></a></div>
   <div class="hero-mini rise-in" style="animation-delay:.52s"><span>Made for moments that matter</span><i></i><span>Designed to keep things simple</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="globe-shell" id="globeShell" aria-hidden="true">
   <img class="globe-poster" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="" decoding="async">
   <canvas class="orbit-canvas" id="globeCanvas"></canvas>
   <div class="globe-label one"><i>↗</i><div><b>Across borders</b><small>One connected journey</small></div></div>
   <div class="globe-label two"><i>✓</i><div><b>Always in the loop</b><small>From send to arrival</small></div></div>
   <div class="globe-label three"><i>◎</i><div><b>Made to connect</b><small>Closer, from anywhere</small></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="globe-chapter"><span class="mini-label">A world without the waiting</span><h2>One world. A million connections.</h2></div>
  <div class="scroll-indicator"><i></i><span>Scroll to explore</span></div><div class="hero-bottom-index mono">01 / AN OPEN WORLD</div>
 </div>
</section>
<section class="rates" id="rates">
 <div class="page-wrap rates-grid">
  <div class="rates-copy scroll-reveal"><span class="mini-label">02 / THE TRANSFER</span><h2>Know the cost.<br>Feel the ease.</h2><p>Less time guessing. More confidence sending. Preview an example transfer to see how a simple, transparent send flow could work.</p><div class="rates-steps"><div><span>01</span><div><strong>Choose your currencies</strong><small>Explore sending and receiving amounts.</small></div></div><div><span>02</span><div><strong>See everything up front</strong><small>One clear fee and rate breakdown.</small></div></div><div><span>03</span><div><strong>Make your move</strong><small>Start the sign-up journey when you're ready.</small></div></div></div></div>
  <div class="calc-wrap scroll-reveal" style="--delay:120ms"><div class="calc-glow"></div><div class="transfer-card"><div class="calc-heading"><h3>Transfer preview</h3><span class="demo-tag">ILLUSTRATIVE DEMO</span></div><label for="sendAmount" class="calc-input-label">You send</label><div class="amount-control"><input id="sendAmount" aria-label="Amount to send" type="number" min="1" max="100000" step="10" value="1000"><select id="sendCurrency" aria-label="Send currency"><option value="USD">USD</option><option value="EUR">EUR</option><option value="GBP">GBP</option><option value="SGD">SGD</option><option value="AUD">AUD</option><option value="CAD">CAD</option></select></div><div class="swap-bar"><button id="swapCurrency" class="swap-btn" type="button" aria-label="Swap send and receive currencies">⇅</button></div><label for="receiveAmount" class="calc-input-label">Recipient gets (estimated)</label><div class="amount-control"><input id="receiveAmount" aria-label="Recipient receives" type="text" readonly value="0"><select id="receiveCurrency" aria-label="Receive currency"><option value="PHP">PHP</option><option value="INR">INR</option><option value="EUR">EUR</option><option value="GBP">GBP</option><option value="JPY">JPY</option><option value="USD">USD</option><option value="SGD">SGD</option><option value="AUD">AUD</option><option value="CAD">CAD</option></select></div><div class="calc-details"><div><span>Sample transfer fee</span><strong id="calcFee">—</strong></div><div><span>Illustrative exchange rate</span><strong id="calcRate">—</strong></div><div class="total-row"><span>Estimated received</span><strong id="calcTotal">—</strong></div></div><button class="cta-btn cta-dark calc-submit" type="button" data-open-signup>Sign up to get started <span>↗</span></button><p class="calc-note">Demo rates only — not live quotes, offers, or a guarantee of delivery time.</p></div></div>

<!-- Recolored and re-composed from supplied orbit-globe/bg.js procedural globe -->
<script>/* Orbit — motion background
 * Usage: <canvas data-bg></canvas> inside any positioned container, then <script src="bg.js"><\/script>.
 * No canvas found → a fixed full-screen one is created behind the page.
 */
(() => {
  const canvas = document.getElementById('globeCanvas');
  if (!canvas) return;
  const gl = canvas.getContext('webgl', { antialias:false, alpha:true, premultipliedAlpha:false });
  if (!gl) return; // Optimized globe artwork remains visible as a fallback.
  gl.clearColor(0,0,0,0);
  addEventListener('pagehide', () => { const x = gl.getExtension('WEBGL_lose_context'); if (x) x.loseContext(); });   /* free the GPU context when the page/iframe goes away */

  const vert = `attribute vec2 p;void main(){gl_Position=vec4(p,0.,1.);}`;
  const frag = `
precision highp float;
uniform vec2 r; uniform float t; uniform vec2 m;
// Dotted globe: analytic sphere, latitude-balanced dot grid, procedural continents, atmosphere,
// and great-circle data arcs with comet heads (hidden behind the planet), endpoint pulses.
const float PI=3.14159265;
const float F=1.36;   // focal length
float h31(vec3 p){p=fract(p*.3183099+.1);p*=17.;return fract(p.x*p.y*p.z*(p.x+p.y+p.z));}
float n3(vec3 x){vec3 i=floor(x),f=fract(x);f=f*f*(3.-2.*f);
  return mix(mix(mix(h31(i),h31(i+vec3(1,0,0)),f.x),mix(h31(i+vec3(0,1,0)),h31(i+vec3(1,1,0)),f.x),f.y),
             mix(mix(h31(i+vec3(0,0,1)),h31(i+vec3(1,0,1)),f.x),mix(h31(i+vec3(0,1,1)),h31(i+vec3(1,1,1)),f.x),f.y),f.z);}
float land(vec3 p){float v=n3(p*2.6+2.)*.55+n3(p*5.2+7.)*.3+n3(p*10.+3.)*.15;return smoothstep(.455,.485,v)*smoothstep(.97,.8,abs(p.y));}
mat3 rotY(float a){float c=cos(a),s=sin(a);return mat3(c,0.,-s,0.,1.,0.,s,0.,c);}
mat3 rotX(float a){float c=cos(a),s=sin(a);return mat3(1.,0.,0.,0.,c,s,0.,-s,c);}
vec3 ll(float la,float lo){la*=PI/180.;lo*=PI/180.;return vec3(cos(la)*sin(lo),sin(la),cos(la)*cos(lo));}
void ends(int k,out vec3 A,out vec3 B){
  if(k==0){A=ll(38.,-110.);B=ll(50.,5.);}
  else if(k==1){A=ll(50.,5.);B=ll(14.,75.);}
  else if(k==2){A=ll(14.,75.);B=ll(-2.,112.);}
  else if(k==3){A=ll(-2.,112.);B=ll(36.,140.);}
  else if(k==4){A=ll(40.,-75.);B=ll(-20.,-48.);}
  else{A=ll(50.,5.);B=ll(-25.,25.);}
}
float seg(vec2 p,vec2 a,vec2 b){vec2 pa=p-a,ba=b-a;float h=clamp(dot(pa,ba)/max(dot(ba,ba),1e-6),0.,1.);return length(pa-ba*h);}
vec2 proj(vec3 V){return V.xy*F/(3.2-V.z);}
void main(){
  vec2 uv=(gl_FragCoord.xy-.5*r)/r.y;
  float sa=r.x/r.y;
  vec2 u=uv;
  float rotA=t*.07+(m.x-.5)*.7, tilt=.38+(m.y-.5)*.3;
  mat3 R=rotX(tilt)*rotY(rotA);
  vec3 ro=vec3(0.,0.,3.2), rd=normalize(vec3(u,-F));

  // Transparent background: the page supplies ONE continuous atmosphere.
  // Only the globe, its soft halo and emissive transfer paths produce opacity.
  vec3 col=vec3(0.);
  float alpha=0.;

  float b=dot(ro,rd), c=dot(ro,ro)-1., disc=b*b-c;
  float dmin=length(ro-rd*b);
  // atmosphere halo
  float halo=exp(-max(dmin-1.,0.)*17.)*step(1.,dmin);
  col+=vec3(.15,.89,.62)*halo*.43;
  alpha=max(alpha,halo*.46);
  if(disc>0.){
    // Antialias the actual sphere limb rather than masking a rectangular image.
    alpha=max(alpha,smoothstep(0.,.018,disc));
    float tt=-b-sqrt(disc);
    vec3 pv=ro+rd*tt, po=pv*R;                     // view → object (v*R = transpose(R)*v)
    float facing=max(dot(pv,-rd),0.);
    float lat=asin(clamp(po.y,-1.,1.)), lon=atan(po.x,po.z);
    const float ROWS=90.;
    float row=floor((lat+PI*.5)/PI*ROWS);
    float latc=(row+.5)/ROWS*PI-PI*.5;
    float cnt=max(1.,floor(2.*ROWS*cos(latc)));
    float li=floor((lon+PI)/(2.*PI)*cnt);
    float lonc=(li+.5)/cnt*2.*PI-PI;
    vec3 dc=vec3(cos(latc)*sin(lonc),sin(latc),cos(latc)*cos(lonc));
    float dotR=PI/ROWS*.3;
    float dm=smoothstep(dotR,dotR*.45,length(po-dc));
    float L=land(dc);
    vec3 base=vec3(.006,.037,.047)+vec3(.025,.25,.18)*pow(1.-facing,2.5);   // dark sphere with blue limb
    vec3 dcol=mix(vec3(.12,.40,.35)*.22,vec3(.53,1.,.78),L);
    col=base+dcol*dm*(.25+.75*facing);
    // a slow scan band of light sweeping across the land
    float scan=exp(-pow(sin(lon*.5-t*.25)*6.,2.));
    col+=vec3(.26,.96,.66)*dm*L*scan*.5;
  }
  // arcs
  for(int k=0;k<6;k++){
    vec3 A,B; ends(k,A,B);
    float ang=acos(clamp(dot(A,B),-1.,1.));
    float ph=fract(t*.16+float(k)*.173)*1.5;            // 0..1 travel, then a pause
    vec2 pv=vec2(0.); float pvis=0.;
    float acc=0.;
    for(int j=0;j<=26;j++){
      float s=float(j)/26.;
      vec3 P=normalize(mix(A,B,s))*(1.+.14*ang*sin(PI*s));
      vec3 V=R*P;
      vec2 sp=proj(V);
      float vis=(V.z>-.05||length(V.xy)>1.)?1.:0.;
      if(j>0){
        float w=smoothstep(ph-.5,ph,s)*step(s,ph)*vis*pvis;
        float d=seg(u,pv,sp);
        acc+=w*(smoothstep(.005,.0,d)*1.1+exp(-d*90.)*.3);
      }
      pv=sp; pvis=vis;
    }
    vec3 ac=mix(vec3(.43,1.,.61),vec3(.20,.89,1.),fract(float(k)*.37));
    col+=ac*acc;
    alpha=max(alpha,clamp(acc*.6,0.,1.));
    // pulses where an arc lands
    vec3 VB=R*B;
    if(VB.z>0.){
      float d=length(u-proj(VB));
      float land_=smoothstep(.85,1.,ph)*smoothstep(1.4,1.,ph);
      float rr=fract(t*.8+float(k))*.045;
      float pulse=(smoothstep(.003,.0,abs(d-rr))*(1.-rr/.045)+smoothstep(.006,.002,d))*(.35+land_);
      col+=ac*pulse;
      alpha=max(alpha,clamp(pulse*.75,0.,1.));
    }
  }
  vec2 q=gl_FragCoord.xy/r;
  col*=1.-.3*dot(q-.5,q-.5);
  col=1.-exp(-col*1.3);
  // Important: RGB can glow outside the sphere, but the rest is transparent.
  // The 3D sphere ends at radius ~.447; gently stop atmospheric alpha
  // before the square canvas boundary at radius .50 to prevent a visible box.
  float canvasFeather=1.-smoothstep(.458,.497,length(uv));
  gl_FragColor=vec4(col,clamp(alpha*canvasFeather,0.,1.));
}
`;
  const sh = (type, src) => { const s = gl.createShader(type); gl.shaderSource(s, src); gl.compileShader(s); if (!gl.getShaderParameter(s, gl.COMPILE_STATUS)) console.error(gl.getShaderInfoLog(s)); return s; };
  const prog = gl.createProgram();
  gl.attachShader(prog, sh(gl.VERTEX_SHADER, vert));
  gl.attachShader(prog, sh(gl.FRAGMENT_SHADER, frag));
  gl.bindAttribLocation(prog, 0, 'p');
  gl.linkProgram(prog); gl.useProgram(prog);
  gl.bindBuffer(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, gl.createBuffer());
  gl.bufferData(gl.ARRAY_BUFFER, new Float32Array([-1,-1,3,-1,-1,3]), gl.STATIC_DRAW);
  gl.enableVertexAttribArray(0); gl.vertexAttribPointer(0, 2, gl.FLOAT, false, 0, 0);
  const U = n => gl.getUniformLocation(prog, n), ur = U('r'), ut = U('t'), um = U('m'), uo = U('o');
  const focus = (canvas.dataset.focus || '.5,.5').split(',').map(Number); // optional: <canvas data-bg data-focus="x,y">

  const SCALE = 0.78; // render scale vs CSS pixels — lower = faster, softer
  const resize = () => { const P = /[?&]preview/.test(location.search) ? .5 : 1; canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth * SCALE * P; canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight * SCALE * P; gl.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height); };
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(canvas); resize();

  let mx = .5, my = .5, tx = mx, ty = my, visible = true;
  addEventListener('pointermove', e => { const b = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(); tx = (e.clientX - b.left) / b.width; ty = 1 - (e.clientY - b.top) / b.height; });
  new IntersectionObserver(([e]) => visible = e.isIntersecting).observe(canvas);
  const still = matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const frame = now => {
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    if (!visible) return;
    mx += (tx - mx) * .04; my += (ty - my) * .04;
    gl.uniform2f(ur, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    gl.uniform1f(ut, canvas.time != null ? canvas.time : still ? 20 : (now - t0) / 1000);
    gl.uniform2f(um, mx, my);
    if (uo) gl.uniform2f(uo, focus[0], focus[1]);
    gl.clear(gl.COLOR_BUFFER_BIT); gl.drawArrays(gl.TRIANGLES, 0, 3); if (!canvas.dataset.ready) { canvas.dataset.ready = "1"; document.getElementById("globeShell").classList.add("gl-ready"); }
  };
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
})();
</script>
<script>
(()=>{
'use strict';
const $=(s,root=document)=>root.querySelector(s), $$=(s,root=document)=>[...root.querySelectorAll(s)];
const reduced=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
// Sticky globe: every scroll position maps to an exact reversible visual state.
const runway=$('#top'),frame=$('#heroFrame'),nav=$('#siteNav');let scrollPending=false;
function updateScroll(){scrollPending=false;const box=runway.getBoundingClientRect(),travel=Math.max(1,runway.offsetHeight-innerHeight);const p=reduced?0:Math.min(1,Math.max(0,-box.top/travel));frame.style.setProperty('--p',p.toFixed(4));nav.classList.toggle('scrolled',scrollY>30)}
addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(!scrollPending){scrollPending=true;requestAnimationFrame(updateScroll)}},{passive:true});addEventListener('resize',()=>requestAnimationFrame(updateScroll),{passive:true});updateScroll();
// Reveal targets become visible even if an observer cannot initialize.
const reveal=$$('.scroll-reveal');if('IntersectionObserver' in window && !reduced){const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{for(const e of entries){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('revealed');obs.unobserve(e.target)}}},{threshold:.06,rootMargin:'0px 0px 80px 0px'});reveal.forEach(el=>obs.observe(el))}else reveal.forEach(el=>el.classList.add('revealed'));
// Menu
const toggle=$('#menuToggle'),mobile=$('#mobileNav');function closeMenu(){mobile.classList.remove('open');toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');toggle.setAttribute('aria-label','Open navigation')}toggle.addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=!mobile.classList.contains('open');mobile.classList.toggle('open',open);toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));toggle.setAttribute('aria-label',open?'Close navigation':'Open navigation')});$$('.mobile-nav a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',closeMenu));document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeMenu()});
// Conversion demo. Always explicit that this is not a real sign-up.
const modal=$('#signupModal'),email=$('#signupEmail'),form=$('#signupForm'),success=$('#signupSuccess');
function openModal(){closeMenu();success.classList.remove('show');form.style.display='block';if(typeof modal.showModal==='function'){modal.showModal();setTimeout(()=>email.focus(),90)}else modal.setAttribute('open','')}
$$('[data-open-signup]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',openModal));$('#modalClose').addEventListener('click',()=>modal.close());modal.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target===modal)modal.close()});form.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();if(!form.reportValidity())return;form.style.display='none';success.classList.add('show')});
// Illustrative currency estimator. All rates are deliberately fixed examples.
const usdValue={USD:1,EUR:1.09,GBP:1.27,SGD:.74,AUD:.66,CAD:.72,PHP:1/57.8,INR:1/84.1,JPY:1/147.3};
const amount=$('#sendAmount'),send=$('#sendCurrency'),receive=$('#receiveCurrency'),out=$('#receiveAmount');
const fmt=(n,code)=>new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{style:'currency',currency:code,maximumFractionDigits:code==='JPY'?0:2}).format(n);
function estimate(){const n=Math.min(100000,Math.max(0,parseFloat(amount.value)||0)),from=send.value,to=receive.value,fee=Math.max(.9,n*.005),rate=usdValue[from]/usdValue[to],net=Math.max(0,n-fee);out.value=new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US',{maximumFractionDigits:to==='JPY'?0:2,minimumFractionDigits:to==='JPY'?0:2}).format(net*rate);$('#calcFee').textContent=fmt(fee,from);$('#calcRate').textContent='1 '+from+' ≈ '+rate.toLocaleString('en-US',{maximumFractionDigits:4})+' '+to;$('#calcTotal').textContent=fmt(net*rate,to)}
[amount,send,receive].forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('input',estimate));[send,receive].forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('change',estimate));$('#swapCurrency').addEventListener('click',()=>{const from=send.value,to=receive.value;if(![...send.options].some(o=>o.value===to))send.add(new Option(to,to));if(![...receive.options].some(o=>o.value===from))receive.add(new Option(from,from));send.value=to;receive.value=from;estimate()});estimate();
const refresh=(el)=>{el.classList.remove('refresh');void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('refresh')};
const flowData=[['01 / GET STARTED','It begins with you.','Enter an amount and choose the currency you want to send. That’s your first step.'],['02 / SEE THE DETAILS','Clarity looks good.','Explore an estimated exchange rate and sample transfer fee in one understandable view.'],['03 / MAKE YOUR MOVE','Ready when you are.','Review the essentials, choose your recipient, and take the next step with confidence.'],['04 / STAY CONNECTED','Keep the good news close.','An example timeline shows how delivery updates and confirmations might work.']];
function setFlow(i){$$('[data-flow]').forEach((b,j)=>{b.classList.toggle('active',i===j);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===j))});const [ey,t,body]=flowData[i];$('#flowEyebrow').textContent=ey;$('#flowTitle').textContent=t;$('#flowText').textContent=body;$('#flowProgress').style.width=((i+1)*25)+'%';refresh($('#flowTitle'));refresh($('#flowText'))}$$('[data-flow]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>setFlow(+b.dataset.flow)));
const stories=[['For the people who matter.','Support someone you love, wherever the day finds them.','Because distance shouldn’t feel difficult.','An approachable way to support the moments that matter.'],['Your work deserves to travel.','Get closer to the people and projects that help your ideas go further.','Work without borders.','Imagine a simpler journey for international earnings and payments.'],['The world feels more like home.','Stay connected to the places and people that make a new city feel familiar.','Bring your world with you.','One more way to make life across borders feel connected.']];
$$('[data-story]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const i=+btn.dataset.story;$$('[data-story]').forEach((b,j)=>{b.classList.toggle('active',i===j);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===j))});$('#storyTitle').textContent=stories[i][0];$('#storyCopy').textContent=stories[i][1];$('#storyEmphasis').textContent=stories[i][2];$('#storyDetail').textContent=stories[i][3];refresh($('#storyTitle'));refresh($('#storyCopy'))}));
const routes=[['New York to Manila','Different cities. One shared moment.'],['London to Mumbai','Make the miles feel a little smaller.'],['Singapore to Tokyo','From one good place to another.']];
$$('[data-route]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{const i=+btn.dataset.route;$$('[data-route]').forEach((b,j)=>{b.classList.toggle('active',i===j);b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(i===j))});$('#routeTitle').textContent=routes[i][0];$('#routeText').textContent=routes[i][1];refresh($('#routeTitle'));refresh($('#routeText'))}));
$$('.faq-q').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const was=b.getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true';$$('.faq-q').forEach(q=>{q.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');q.nextElementSibling.classList.remove('open')});if(!was){b.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');b.nextElementSibling.classList.add('open')}}));
// Accessible card motion with pointer feedback; no transform-tilt on touch devices.
if(matchMedia('(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine)').matches&&!reduced){$$('.transfer-card,.closing-scene,.flow-visual').forEach(el=>{el.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(),x=(e.clientX-r.left)/r.width-.5,y=(e.clientY-r.top)/r.height-.5;el.style.setProperty('--mx',x.toFixed(3));el.style.setProperty('--my',y.toFixed(3))})})}
})();
</script>
</body></html>
